contentPattern.structure: background image + heading + optional description + optional CTA

suitableFor: single full-bleed banner with overlaid heading/description/CTA (e.g. 'Climbing New Zealand' adventure teaser)
minor-locale 'coming soon' stub hero (heading over a background image; description/CTA omitted)
adventure-detail / article-detail full-bleed LEAD image at top of page (image only; heading/description/CTA omitted so it renders as a pure image band, title sits below on white)

notes: Fetched from Block Collection hero (the project's local hero.js was empty). JS adds a 'no-image' class when no background image is present, so the coming-soon stub (heading only) renders correctly. DA project, so no _hero-banner.json model file. Serves the homepage in-page banner + GAP1 de/de coming-soon stub, the adventure-detail full-bleed lead image, and now the article-detail (magazine) full-bleed lead image (image-only, no overlaid text).
